title: Inventory Status Determination & Calculation
description: Rules and formulas used by the demand forecasting engine to dynamically determine SKU inventory statuses based on predicted demand, current stock, safety stock, and lead time.

formulas.reorder_point: (Lead Time Days * Daily Sales) + Safety Stock

Deadstock.name: Deadstock
Deadstock.summary: Low turnover or idle inventory tying up working capital.
Deadstock.calculation: Stock > 0 AND (Daily Sales < 1 unit/day OR Days of Supply > 365 days)
Deadstock.details: Days of Supply = Current Stock / Daily Sales (estimated days current stock will last). Triggered when inventory exceeds 365 days of projected demand, or sales velocity is under 1 unit per day.
Deadstock.action: Liquidate, discount, bundle, or halt replenishment to free up capital.

Critical.name: Critical
Critical.summary: Stock has reached or breached safety stock buffer with immediate stockout risk.
Critical.details: Stock is at or below the minimum reserve buffer designed to protect against demand surges and supplier delays.
Critical.action: Initiate emergency replenishment or expedite supplier shipment immediately.

Reorder.name: Reorder
Reorder.summary: Current stock has reached or dropped below Reorder Point (ROP).
Reorder.details: Stock will run out before new delivery arrives unless an order is placed now.
Reorder.action: Place purchase order according to standard replenishment quantity.

Monitor.name: Monitor
Monitor.summary: Approaching reorder threshold or projected to reach ROP during lead time.
Monitor.calculation: Current Stock <= ROP * 1.2 OR (Current Stock - Lead Time * Daily Sales) <= ROP
Monitor.details: Stock is safe today but within 20% of reorder trigger, or sales run-rate will deplete inventory into reorder level during delivery time.
Monitor.action: Monitor daily consumption closely and prepare purchase requisitions.

In Stock.name: In Stock
In Stock.summary: Healthy inventory level with adequate buffer above reorder thresholds.
In Stock.details: Inventory levels are balanced against expected customer demand and supplier lead times.
In Stock.action: Normal operations; no replenishment action required.
